page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no margin notes. Running head "PRAEFATIO" at the top. Below the text, a woodcut ornament (a mask within scrollwork, with tassels), which carries no text.

main_text.p: taret:quam indolem Deum Opt. Maximum oro, ut ad frugem & maturitatem perducat: teq;, Generosissime Comes, ita benevolentia sua complectatur, ut te quā primum inter summos Germania proceres florentem, beatum, atque illustrem videamus.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is an engraved decoration and is not transcribed. The initial M of "Maximum" is a decorative capital. The printed "teq" carries a abbreviation mark, transcribed as "teq;". No page number, catchword or signature is printed on this page.
